audience: Shoppers looking for a modest handmade gift
hook: A small gift with its own pattern
script: Show the bar as a gift idea, then its natural batch variation. End on the exact product name and a link to see the current bar.
static_layout: Product photo centered with simple gift-note typography. No packaging shown unless the actual packaging is supplied. Avoid invented ribbons, bundles or included accessories.

shots.visual: Use exact original product photo; frame the flecked surface with a restrained crop.
shots.overlay: A small gift with its own pattern

shots.visual: Slowly reveal the complete original bar. Preserve shape and star embossing; no synthetic product motion.
Hold the real product image with a small brand credit and clear CTA.

audio.direction: Use a quiet, owned recording of the real product being placed on a surface. No added fake production sounds; request recording before render.
